consequence.statement: When JMX is enabled, the JVM default IP address preference now applies instead of the implicit IPv4 preference. IPv6-only clusters now boot correctly.

original.statement: The implicit IPv4 preference applied when JMX is enabled has been removed; the JVM defaults now apply.

decision.reason: [ev-6b927d45a8a3] says the implicit IPv4 preference applied when JMX is enabled has been removed and the JVM defaults now apply. It presents this as a fix that lets clusters boot correctly in IPv6-only environments, and it doesn't say anything fails, is rejected or needs migrating. A changed default that keeps working is behavior-change (review class), and low severity fits.
